const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
 "const subs=['beermoney','Entrepreneur','indiehackers','webdev','passive_income'];\n",
 "let i=0;",
 "function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms)});}",
 "async function next(){",
 " if(i>=subs.length) return;",
 " const s=subs[i++];",
 " const u='https://www.reddit.com/r/'+s+'/top/.rss?t=year';",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " await sleep(4000);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/rss+xml'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',async function(){",
 " const xml=Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8');",
 " const entries=xml.split('<entry>').slice(1);",
 " console.log('\\n########## r/'+s+' ('+entries.length+' entries) ##########');",
 " for(const e of entries.slice(0,10)){",
 " const t=/<title>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(e);",
 " const ct=/<content type=\"html\">([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/content>/.exec(e);",
 " const title=t?t[1].replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)):'?';",
 " let body=ct?ct[1].replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' '):'';",
 " console.log('--- '+title);",
 " console.log(body.substring(0,320));",
 " }",
 " await next();",
 " });",
 " }).on('error',async function(e){console.log('r/'+s+' ERR '+e.message); await next();});",
 "}",
 "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-rss2.cjs", content: js });

const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
  "const subs=['beermoney','Entrepreneur','indiehackers','webdev','passive_income'];\n",
  "let i=0;",
  "function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms)});}",
  "async function next(){",
  "  if(i>=subs.length) return;",
  "  const s=subs[i++];",
  "  const u='https://www.reddit.com/r/'+s+'/top/.rss?t=year';",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  await sleep(4000);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/rss+xml'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',async function(){",
  "      const xml=Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8');",
  "      const entries=xml.split('<entry>').slice(1);",
  "      console.log('\\n########## r/'+s+' ('+entries.length+' entries) ##########');",
  "      for(const e of entries.slice(0,10)){",
  "        const t=/<title>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(e);",
  "        const ct=/<content type=\"html\">([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/content>/.exec(e);",
  "        const title=t?t[1].replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)):'?';",
  "        let body=ct?ct[1].replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' '):'';",
  "        console.log('--- '+title);",
  "        console.log(body.substring(0,320));",
  "      }",
  "      await next();",
  "    });",
  "  }).on('error',async function(e){console.log('r/'+s+' ERR '+e.message); await next();});",
  "}",
  "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-rss2.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-rss2.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch multiple subreddits via RSS", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 16000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));
